schemaVersion: v1alpha1
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: reviewer
spec:
  idleTimeoutMinutes: 5
  maxTurns: 30
  steer:
    enabled: true
  tools:
    - read_file
    - gh_review
  runtime:
    # model removed while testing a new provider
    image: ghcr.io/acme/worker-base:2026.10
    memory: 4Gi
